title: Custom Application and Field Services: Reschedule Allowances and Cancellation Charges by Programme
content:
A programme of Custom Application and Field Services fixes four figures at the counter: how many reschedules a work order may take without charge, what a reschedule beyond that count costs, how many hours of notice a member needs to cancel a scheduled pass without charge, and what a cancellation inside that notice costs. It also fixes whether a pass washed out by rain after the product is down is charged again when it is rerun.

| Programme | Reschedules without charge (count) | Charge for a reschedule beyond the count (USD) | Notice to cancel a scheduled pass (hours) | Charge for cancelling inside the notice (USD) | A rain-washed pass is charged again on the rerun |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Per-Acre Custom Application | 1 | 75.00 | 24 | 150.00 | Yes |
| Season Commitment Application Plan | 2 | 75.00 | 24 | 150.00 | Yes |
| Full-Service Agronomy Plan | 3 | 60.00 | 24 | 125.00 | No |
| Variable Rate Prescription Plan | 3 | 60.00 | 48 | 200.00 | No |
| Precision Partner Whole-Farm Plan | 5 | 50.00 | 48 | 0.00 | No |
| Certified Anhydrous Application Plan | 1 | 100.00 | 48 | 250.00 | Yes |

The free reschedule count is a count of moves on one work order, and the charge attaches to each move past it. The notice figure is a length in hours ahead of the scheduled pass. On the Precision Partner Whole-Farm Plan the cancellation charge is 0.00 USD, so a cancellation inside the notice period carries no charge on that programme although the notice figure of 48 hours is still the programme's figure.
